name: Benchmark Curve Name 6 Choice
definition: Choice of format for benchmark curve name.

ISIN.name: ISIN
ISIN.definition: International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) identifier of an index / benchmark.

Index.name: Index
Index.definition: Name of the index / benchmark of a floating rate bond.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Provides the name that should be used where no ISIN or standardized name of the index exists, including its term (such as ‘EURIBOR6M’, ‘LIBOR3M’).
